name: ElegantFin TV
description: Minimal ElegantFin design with native Jellyfin motion and Media Bar focus support. Requires a compatible File Transformation plugin. LG C4 integration still requires on-device verification.

versions.changelog: Add Jelly+ styling and seasonal-row remote navigation. Keep player button focus inside clipped OSD headers and remove rectangular range focus. Desktop seasonal and Jelly+ extensions are available as separate release assets.

overview: ElegantFin for webOS and TV layouts
